offers_products.reason: Makes air conditioners, furnaces, heat pumps, rooftop units, refrigeration systems and thermostats.

offers_services.reason: Commercial Services offers multi-site businesses preventative maintenance and planned replacement. Products are still the larger part.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Residential HVAC is the larger business. Homeowners choose Lennox systems and buy them through dealers.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to independent dealers and contractors, and to commercial buyers such as retailers, schools and supermarkets.

recurring_revenue.reason: Most sales are equipment purchased every 10 to 20 years per customer. Parts and services recur but are the smaller share.

cyclical_demand.reason: Most sales are replacement furnaces and air conditioners, which are needed when equipment fails. New construction is cyclical but is the smaller part.

big_ticket.reason: Much of the revenue is replacement HVAC systems, which are large and infrequent for homeowners. Dealers, contractors and parts buyers purchase more often.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from manufactured HVAC equipment, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main buyers are independent dealers and contractors, plus homeowners. Commercial services for multi-site businesses are a smaller part.

asset_heavy.reason: Manufactures HVAC equipment in its own plants, and it needs continuing investment in factories and distribution.

notes: The segment mix comes from general knowledge. It includes a Residential segment (the largest), Commercial and Refrigeration. Answers about revenue patterns are judgments.
